gaps: `work complete --evidence TYPE=PATH` only checks that each path exists: FileEvidenceRepository.observe calls File.GetAttributes on Path.Combine(root, path) (src/Praxis.Infrastructure/Work/FileEvidenceRepository.fs:10-17); no content, digest, test outcome, or root-containment check (Path.Combine accepts absolute paths). Required types come from ros.json workProtocol.completionEvidence (default: implementation, tests) and are matched only by type name (Model.fs:70-75).

The PRX-QUAL-023 completion-readiness gate that does judge Dokimos/Ordo verdicts (QualityEvidenceCommands.completionGate, Program.fs:1489) returns NotApplicable unless ros.json has workProtocol.qualityEvidence; none of the 7 repos' ros.json defines it (observed), so the gate does nothing in practice.

Two completion paths with different strength: legacy `work complete` (existence-only) vs `work complete-verified` (claim token + fencing generation + ValidatedEvidence + Dokimos receipt). parseEvidence in Program.fs:234 has no @sha256 support while ClaimArguments.evidence (ClaimArguments.fs:63-69) does.
Even the readiness gate trusts producer verdict strings: VerificationEvidenceItem.Result is a string, ReleaseReadinessEvidence.Verdict is self-declared (CompletionReadiness.fs:135-182).

Stale docs: context/CURRENT-STATE.md (last changed 2026-10-14) says remote execution lives on unmerged PR #91 and does not mention autonomy/claims/verified completion; docs/ROADMAP-STATUS.md 'Updated: 2026-08-16' says daemon/model routing is out of scope while local worker dispatch/autonomy now exists.
20 src files cite `tools/ros_cli.mjs` as the production behavior being mirrored, but no tools/ directory exists in Praxis (Node implementation retired).
